style: Vintage 1970s rally racing poster illustration, flat gouache painting with silkscreen print grain, bold simplified color blocks, limited palette, graphic stylized shapes, matte paper texture, not photorealistic, no glossy plastic look. suffix: Wide panoramic band of distant landscape painted as flat layered silhouette shapes in tones of a single color, the landscape occupies the lower half and runs off the left, right and bottom edges, above it a plain flat empty white sky with nothing in it, no sun, no clouds, no birds, no text, no border.
